chunks.text: I was cleaning up my notes from that 2025 work trip—Shanghai was a blur, but it was actually a pretty fun city once I got a minute to breathe.
My colleague Chen Ming handled the stay, and we ended up at Hyatt on the Bund—super classic view, honestly.
Pretty sure we checked in on 2025-03-21 and just did 3 nights before heading out again.
Then right after that I met friends in Chengdu—people kept talking about attractions there like it’s impossible to run out of things to do.
We actually went to Wuhou Shrine on 2025-03-13, and the tickets were under Zhang Wei—there were 4 of us in total.
They picked the 16:00 slot, and yeah, we had 4 tickets—after that we just wandered around and talked about which restaurants in Chengdu were overrated.
Oh and later that month in Beijing, I remember checking what movies were on, and Zhou Jun had already bought 2 seats for The Wandering Earth 3 at Bona International—showtime was 21:50.
